findings.description: The attempt-1 defect is fixed and re-verified. Step 6 and Step U7 now resolve profile-placeholder per Step 1 rule instead of a raw tilde. Both are agent-executed sites, which is exactly where the domain-HOME hazard documented in The tilde trap applies.
findings.evidence: git show 3b19a49 in worktree C:/Users/mharvey2/Coding/aaw worktrees/aaw-packaging-repair shows the Step 6 and Step U7 hunks replacing tilde-based paths with profile-based backslash paths. Grep across .claude/skills/setup-with-claude/SKILL.md in that worktree returns only prose lines and the Step R2 fenced commands handed to the user to run in their own terminal, consistent with SKILL.md lines 147-149: Tell the user to run the commands in a terminal outside this Claude Code session, do NOT attempt to run the install commands yourself.

findings.location: criterion No global path in the installer resolves through tilde or HOME, full-installer sweep
findings.description: Judgment on the R2 carve-out and a site-by-site sweep beyond the patched file: the carve-out is sound. Every remaining tilde or HOME occurrence in setup-with-claude SKILL.md is descriptive prose or inside a fenced command block explicitly handed to the user to run outside the Claude Code session, never executed by the skill itself. detect.py resolves the profile via USERPROFILE and HOMEDRIVE plus HOMEPATH on Windows and HOME on POSIX. installed.json writes are schema-forbidden from containing tilde or HOME or USERPROFILE literals. The PostToolUse hook resolves at runtime via Node os.homedir, not via shell tilde expansion.
findings.evidence: references/install-superpowers.md lines 32-38 and references/install-advanced-planning.md lines 7-39 both give separate POSIX and Windows PowerShell command blocks, matching SKILL.md Step 2 framing at lines 146-149 about presenting exact commands for the user platform.

findings.description: Pre-existing gap, not introduced or touched by this phase fix commit (git show 3b19a49 touched only SKILL.md). Unlike sibling reference files, install-gstack.md gives only one universal command using a tilde path with no Windows PowerShell variant, even though SKILL.md Step 2 promises to present exact commands for the user platform (Windows, macOS, Linux). On native Windows PowerShell, an unquoted tilde passed as a git clone destination argument is not shell-expanded and creates a literal directory named tilde rather than resolving to the profile, a different and more visible failure mode than the Git-Bash AD-HOME redirection hazard this phase otherwise fixed. Recorded as Important rather than Critical: it does not violate the literal criterion since the skill still hands the command to the user rather than resolving it itself, it predates phase 4, and it is not named in this phase success-criteria list.
findings.evidence: install-gstack.md line 16 has a single command with no PowerShell-specific block, contrasted with install-superpowers.md lines 41-47 and install-advanced-planning.md lines 27-39, both of which have a dedicated Windows PowerShell section using absolute non-tilde paths.
